historical_reviews.deepseek: Passive readback is appropriate, but the literal range query, password argument, truncated inventory and missing Web evidence cannot prove eight GPU channels.

original_test_intent: Validate PWR_UBB_GPU0 through PWR_UBB_GPU7 as eight distinct GPU power channels, with correct physical GPU identity, measurement-point meaning, readable values and enabled thresholds in raw BMC evidence and both Web views.
original_method: The platform/power owner maps GPU0–GPU7 to fitted modules and electrical feeds, defines whether each value is module input, rail output or derived board power and provides load-state-specific limits; automation performs only passive collection.
manual_activity: The platform/power owner binds every GPU index to a fitted module serial and feed, approves measurement semantics and limits, and confirms both Web views. No load change or power action is authorized.
required_inputs: GPU0–GPU7 to physical slot/module serial/BDF or platform locator and applicability
Measurement point: module input, rail output, accelerator-reported power or derived aggregate
Units, scaling, accuracy, sampling window, freshness and aggregation behavior
Approved idle/load-state ranges and enabled thresholds per GPU
Exact SDR/entity and Dashboard/Server Health mappings
Secret-safe passive collector, complete retention and independent power/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Enumerate all eight exact records; the tilde label is not one sensor
Bind readings to fitted GPU serials and feeds; never infer slot identity from index alone
Do not compare instantaneous, averaged and aggregate power as equivalent
Preserve complete SDR and threshold flags; no 100-line truncation
Do not start a workload, change power caps, issue PMBus/power/threshold writes, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on missing/stale/invalid power, feed mismatch, unsafe thermal/electrical state or BMC instability; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify source and owner-approved GPU/power topology
Collect complete read-only SDR and eight exact power records
Parse values, units, state, sampling semantics and enabled thresholds
Prepare both Web entries and passive GPU/feed/thermal context
Perform no workload, power, PMBus or verdict action
engineer_actions: Approve GPU-to-module/feed mapping and measurement semantics
Confirm Web mappings and aggregation/applicability rules
Review eight results with feed/thermal context and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Useful only after exact names are known; the literal range does not enumerate GPU0–GPU7, output is truncated, credentials are exposed and GPU/feed/Web provenance is absent.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secret-safe OOB access to retain full SDR and query each owner-mapped GPU power record separately, then reconcile the same physical module and threshold in both Web views.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: GPU0~7 scope, both Web paths, reading/threshold criterion and 1/1-minute estimates remain; topology and limits are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES GPU/FEED POWER-SEMANTICS AND THRESHOLD PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build an eight-row GPU-serial-to-power-feed matrix and reconcile passive values and enabled thresholds across raw and Web evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical and electrical provenance and expands the range into exact members.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A literal result, generic SDR excerpt or motherboard PSU value cannot establish eight GPU channels.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong measurement-point or aggregation assumptions can mask an overloaded GPU feed despite plausible wattage.

project_override_considerations: Unfitted GPU positions need explicit N/A rules. Shared shunts, dual-feed modules or one aggregate sensor require a versioned coverage allocation rather than duplicating one value across GPU identities.
expected_evidence: Per-member measurement-point semantics, SDR/entity and both Web mappings
Values, units, sampling/freshness and enabled thresholds under documented state
Complete redacted SDR and eight exact outputs with timestamps/status
Passive rail/thermal/SEL/BMC context and missing/stale/aggregate analysis

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row consistently targets eight UBB GPU power channels and Web thresholds. Missing topology, power semantics and numeric limits are readiness inputs, not contradictory targets.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive power-readback path is identifiable; GPU/feed mapping, measurement semantics and limits are supplyable under ED-36.

review_improvement: Adds physical GPU and electrical measurement provenance, exact eight-member coverage and explicit separation from motherboard-PSU power.
independent_technical_reasoning: A watt value is not comparable until its electrical boundary and averaging interval are known. GPU module input, regulator output and chassis-feed power include different losses, while shared shunts can legitimately cover more than one device. Serial-to-feed binding is therefore required before thresholds can be judged.
